outcome: hemodynamic status (systolic BP, diastolic BP, heart rate, MAP)
cohort: 100 ASA grade I patients undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia with a normal singleton pregnancy beyond 36 weeks gestation
finding: There were no significant differences between ephedrine, phenylephrine, and mephentermine in maintaining hemodynamic status during spinal anesthesia for cesarean section.
